component.name: lwip-core
component.description: G3-PLC additions to lwIP core (LWIP_G3_BUILD=yes only)

properties.name: scope
properties.value: Third-party-derived code vendored by this component only. Meant to be merged into a product-level SBOM, not scanned on its own.

components.name: lwip-lowpan6-g3
components.description: G3-PLC 6LoWPAN adaptation layer: Phoenix-RTOS fork of lwIP's 6LoWPAN implementation, replacing it in G3 builds

pedigree.notes: Forked from lwIP's src/netif/lowpan6.c and src/netif/lowpan6_common.c and extended for G3-PLC. lwIP's own copies are excluded from G3 builds, so lwIP 6LoWPAN advisories apply to these files instead. Upstream fixes to src/netif/lowpan6*.c are not picked up by submodule bumps and must be ported by hand.

properties.name: note
properties.value: No CPE on this component on purpose: the lwIP CPE would attach every lwIP advisory (TCP, DHCP, ...) to it a second time. The ancestor carries the CPE; triage lwIP advisories whose fix touches src/netif/lowpan6*.c against these files.
